acp.enabled: Turn SMSTunnel on for this forum
acp.enabled-help: While this is off, the plugin sends nothing and members don't see it.
acp.key-help: From Apps in your SMSTunnel dashboard. It stays on this server and is never shown again.
acp.key-saved: A key is saved. Leave this empty to keep it.
acp.key-config: The key comes from this forum's configuration file or environment.
acp.alerts-on: Text the numbers below about posts that need attention
acp.alert-queue: When a post waits in the post queue
acp.alerts-help: At most one text of each kind in 10 minutes, with a count of what happened in between. Alerts carry no post content.
acp.staff-help: Up to 5. Each number gets a code first and only receives alerts once that code is entered here.
acp.staff-number: Number, with + and the country code
acp.members-on: Let members turn on texts for replies and mentions
acp.members-help: Each member adds and confirms their own number in their settings. Nobody gets a text they didn't turn on.
acp.member-hour: Most texts per member, per hour
acp.member-day: Most texts per member, per day
acp.forum-day: Most member texts for the whole forum, per day
acp.problem.key-daily-cap: This API key reached its daily limit. Texts past it are not sent.
acp.problem.limit: SMSTunnel refused a text because a limit was reached.
acp.problem.bad-key: SMSTunnel did not accept the API key.
acp.problem.not-allowed: The API key doesn't have permission to send texts.
acp.problem.in-progress: The same text was already being sent.
acp.problem.unclear: SMSTunnel could not be reached or gave no clear answer. The text is not sent again.
acp.problem.invalid-number: A number was not in international format.
member.title: Text messages
member.intro: Get a text when someone replies to your post or mentions you. Texts are off until you add your number and turn them on.
member.phone: Your mobile number, with + and the country code
member.remove-confirm: Remove your number and stop these texts?
member.code-sent: If this number can get texts, a code is on its way.
member.confirmed: Your number is confirmed and texts are on. You can turn them off here anytime.
member.now-off: Texts are off. You will not get any more.
member.removed: Your number was removed and texts are off.
error.bad-number: Please enter one mobile number with + and the country code, for example +40712345678.
error.wait: A code was just sent. Please wait a minute before asking for another.
error.too-many: Too many requests, please try again later.
error.code-not-sent: The code could not be sent. Please try again later.
error.bad-code: That code is not valid. Check the text, or ask for a new code.
error.no-number: Add and confirm your number first.
error.bad-state: That did not work. Please try again.
error.bad-key: That API key doesn't look right.
error.no-staff: That number is no longer on the list.
error.staff-full: You can save up to 5 numbers.
error.staff-duplicate: That number is already on the list.
error.send-key-daily-cap: This API key reached its daily limit. The text was not sent.
error.send-limit: SMSTunnel refused the text because a limit was reached.
error.send-bad-key: SMSTunnel did not accept the API key.
error.send-not-allowed: The API key doesn't have permission to send texts.
error.send-in-progress: This text is already being sent.
error.send-unclear: SMSTunnel could not be reached or gave no clear answer. The text is not sent again.
error.send-invalid-number: That number is not in international format.
